description: Claude in Chrome returned a transient 'not connected' error on the first attempt to view Ryan Menke's LinkedIn profile. Instead of retrying, reported it to David as unavailable and offered alternatives (install/sign into extension, or have him supply the names manually).
correction: David confirmed Chrome is already logged in and the LinkedIn connector is expected to work. A single failed attempt is not sufficient grounds to declare a tool unavailable — retry before reporting a capability as unreachable, per SYSTEM.md's Verification Before Assertion rule ('try harder, minimum 3 search approaches' applies to tool access, not just search).
systemic_fix: Before reporting any browser/connector tool as unavailable, retry at least 2-3 times with a short pause, since Chrome extension handshakes are known to be transient/slow to start. Only report unavailability after repeated failures, and state what was retried.
